newsitem.title: UK: Portugal cotton-buyers active in dull Europe.
newsitem.headline: Portugal cotton-buyers active in dull Europe.

text.p: Portugal bucked the current trend for European mill-buyers to hold back from the raw cotton market until fresh price influences emerge, industry sources said.
Portuguese purchases covered a wide range of growths and delivery dates with African origins for early summer shipment said to have been offered at particularly low rates.
Some enquiry was seen from yarn producers in the Baltic States and France seeking to cover their requirements for individual contracts, but there were no reports of finalised business.
Elsewhere in Europe, the sustained strength of the U.S. dollar coupled with the lack of market-moving fundamental news and flat New York futures brought thin mid-week trade, industry sources said.
